name: taskplane
description: Shared delivery workflow with manual checkpoints, explicitly authorized autonomous approvals, native dashboards and advisory token usage.

interface.longDescription: Product, Design, Plan, Build, Evaluate, Engineering and Retro share validated evidence, source components, a task DAG and one dashboard. Human checkpoints are the default; explicit run-bound instructions can authorize automatic phase approvals with conditions and stops. Show selected-run identity, phase usage and graph provenance. Native permissions and hook trust remain separate; host-wide protection is unavailable.
capabilities: Use manual checkpoints or explicitly authorized automatic phase approval
Bind human and policy decisions to reviewed evidence and scope
Share source graphs, components, task plans and one dashboard
Show run identity, phase token coverage and snapshot freshness
Preserve native permissions and explicit hook trust
defaultPrompt: taskplane design this feature and present the Design checkpoint.
taskplane build this feature with manual phase approval.
taskplane build this feature; auto-approve phases after checks pass, pause on failures or scope changes, stop before Retro.
